title: Pri zdravniku · At the doctor's
setting: A visit to the family doctor in Šempeter. You have had a sore throat and a headache for three days.
role: Dr. Kovač, a calm family doctor. Speaks slowly and clearly, asks one simple question at a time. Says vi to patients.
goals: Say how long you have been ill
Say whether you have a fever
opener_sl: Dober dan. Izvolite, sedite. Kaj vas boli?
opener_en: Hello. Please, have a seat. What hurts?
